integrity: Analytic proof and 283 supplementary executable checks; the independent audit has not been performed. The prior-art review is qualified by possible unindexed equivalent derivations.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional full equispaced lattice only; fixed integer smoothness \(\alpha\ge2\) and fixed positive kernel scale; does not establish positivity of every finite-grid weight, nor the multidimensional rank-one-lattice or subsampled case. Constants may depend on smoothness and kernel scale.
title: Quantified asymptotic positivity for higher-order periodized Korobov quadrature
